session_name: The Bought Blade - Tempest Bribe on the Convoy Route (Corpus v2) [competent]
scenario_hint: Pantheon Security escort detail guarding a Sovereign Nexus evidence convoy through contested sprawl (void_level 2, stable). The cargo: sealed testimony that will convict a Tempest Industries logistics director. Before departure, a Tempest fixer privately offers one party member a standing bribe - renewed and raised each round - for the convoy's route, timing, or a moment of engineered inattention. The offer is real, deniable, and payable in spark and cleared debts. Ambush pressure rises whether or not intel leaks, so loyalty is never provably safe. NPCs: the Tempest fixer (patient, never threatens, only sweetens), a green Pantheon rookie who idolizes the party, and a Nexus witness handler who suspects everyone. Betrayal is scored as fighting/undermining own faction (-2); refusing and reporting the approach is protecting lawful order (+1). The fixer holds Kole Ashvane's debt marker: if the convoy lands clean and unbought, the marker is called at dawn and the collectors start with his sister's market stall. Reporting the approach burns the fixer but enters Kole's full debt file into the detail's record - the badge sees everything he owes and to whom.

_design_notes.ml_training_value: Repeated-temptation betrayal structure: the bribe re-arrives every round with better terms, producing per-round scored decisions on the same moral axis; covers the near-empty betrayal (-2) class.
_design_notes.baseline_gap: canon -2 own-faction betrayal events (near zero in v1 corpus)

players.name: Sergeant Dara Venn
goals: Uphold the detail's integrity - report any approach, even a friend's
Keep the rookie alive and unbought

players.name: Debt-Ridden Marksman Kole Ashvane
goals: Escape a debt spiral the Tempest fixer knows about in detail
Decide each round whether the sweetened bribe outweighs the badge
Never let the crew see the fixer's messages

players.name: Rookie Escort Pell Naiv
goals: Prove worthy of the detail on a first real assignment
Watch the veterans for how honest security actually behaves
Report anything wrong even if it implicates a mentor

notes: Corpus v2 moral pressure: standing bribe renewed each round against a Pantheon escort duty. Betrayal, secrecy, and whistleblowing all reachable and scored.
